description: Baseline: full ComfyUI benchmark on dev branch. Fixed sanity check (find pattern didn't match bin scripts).

asi.hypothesis: Baseline measurement of full ComfyUI benchmark

description: Avoid zero-fill + copy for full-block new writes. Also removed redundant ultracdc_chunk_count call (was computing chunk count just for a debug log). Huge win on lg_write_dura: 54s→20s.

asi.hypothesis: Skip zero-fill+copy for full-block writes to new blocks. Large files (dd bs=1M) write exactly one full block per FUSE message, all new extents, so every block hits the fast path. Removed redundant chunk counting for debug log.

description: Skip SurrealKV range scan when inode.size==0. Regression: 92,543→94,618 (+2.2%). Range scan overhead for empty extents was not significant enough to offset the added branch check.

asi.hypothesis: Skip SurrealKV extent range scan when inode.size==0 (new files) — saves a transaction creation + range iterator for first write to each new file
asi.rollback_reason: Slightly worse perf (+2.2%). Range scan overhead for empty extents is small; branch check adds overhead for non-zero-size files. May be noise but discarding since no improvement.

description: Use point reads for single-block extent scans instead of range iterator. No meaningful change (0.3%, within noise).

asi.hypothesis: Use point reads (meta.get_value) instead of SurrealKV range scan when write touches only 1 block. Avoids iterator creation + seek.
asi.rollback_reason: No measurable improvement. SurrealKV range iterator overhead is small for single-block scans.
asi.next_action_hint: Try optimizing hash computation or write batching

description: Use Arc<Vec<u8>> for pending_chunks to share data between chunk_data_cache and compression. Saves one full copy per new chunk but within noise (0.3%).

asi.hypothesis: Share Arc<Vec<u8>> between chunk_data_cache and pending_chunks to avoid one full-copy per chunk. Changed PendingChunk.data from Vec<u8> to Arc<Vec<u8>>.
asi.rollback_reason: Within noise (0.3%). The saving (~4GB of memory operations across 4344 chunks) is only ~0.9s in a 92s benchmark.
asi.next_action_hint: Look for structural instead of micro optimizations

description: Change stage_chunk_if_missing to take Vec<u8> by value instead of &[u8] to avoid an extra copy. Saves one 1MB alloc+copy per new chunk but regression is within noise (1.5%).

asi.hypothesis: Take Vec<u8> by ownership instead of &[u8] to avoid copy in stage_chunk_if_missing. Saves one full copy per new chunk duration (1MB per block).
asi.rollback_reason: Slightly worse (1.5%), within noise. The saving of 1 copy per chunk doesn't move the needle on this benchmark.
asi.next_action_hint: Try structural change in SurrealKV or pack format
